async function j01Braceless(items: string[], db: Db) {
  for (const item of items)
    // want: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.put(item);
}

async function j02ThenChainLoop(items: string[], db: Db) {
  let chain = Promise.resolve();
  for (const item of items) {
    chain = chain.then(() => db.put(item));
  }
  await chain;
}

async function j03ReduceReturn(items: string[], db: Db) {
  // want: hidden-sequential-loop-javascript
  await items.reduce(async (previous, item) => {
    await previous;
    return db.put(item);
  }, Promise.resolve());
}

async function j04ReduceThenThen(items: string[], db: Db) {
  // want: hidden-sequential-loop-javascript
  await items.reduce((previous, item) => previous.then(() => db.put(item)).then(() => db.audit(item)), Promise.resolve());
}

async function j05ReduceCast(items: string[], db: Db) {
  // want: hidden-sequential-loop-javascript
  await items.reduce((previous, item) => previous.then(() => db.put(item)), Promise.resolve() as Promise<void>);
}

async function j06StepConstBatchAssign(items: string[], db: Db) {
  const SIZE = 10;
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += SIZE) {
    const rows = await Promise.all(items.slice(i, i + SIZE).map((item) => db.get(item)));
    out.push(...rows);
  }
}

async function j07StepLiteralBatchPush(items: string[], db: Db) {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 10) {
    out.push(...(await Promise.all(items.slice(i, i + 10).map((item) => db.get(item)))));
  }
}

async function j08StepBatchSibling(items: string[], db: Db) {
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 10) {
    await Promise.all(items.slice(i, i + 10).map((item) => db.get(item)));
    // want: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.audit(i);
  }
}

async function j09ReturnInClosure(items: string[], db: Db) {
  for (const item of items) {
    const kept = items.filter((other) => {
      return other !== item;
    });
    // want: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.put(kept[0]);
  }
}

async function j10MemberAndTyped(runner: Runner, items: string[], db: Db) {
  // want: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await runner.inOrder(items, db.put);
  // want: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await runner.inOrder<string>(items, db.put, { reason: "" });
  // want: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder<string>(items, db.put);
  // want: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(
    items,
    async (item) => {
      await db.put(item);
    },
  );
}

async function j11ObjectMethodCallback(items: string[], db: Db, handlers: object[]) {
  for (const item of items) {
    handlers.push({
      async run() {
        await db.put(item);
      },
    });
  }
}

async function j12ImmediatelyCalled(items: string[], db: Db) {
  for (const item of items) {
    // want: await-in-loop-javascript
    await (async () => {
      await db.put(item);
    })();
  }
}

async function j13TypedCallback(items: string[], db: Db, callbacks: (() => Promise<void>)[]) {
  for (const item of items) {
    callbacks.push(async (): Promise<void> => {
      await db.put(item);
    });
  }
}

async function j14DoubleAwaitSameExpr(items: string[], db: Db, callbacks: (() => Promise<void>)[]) {
  for (const item of items) {
    callbacks.push(async () => {
      await db.put(item);
    });
    // want: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.put(item);
  }
}

class J15Order {
  async inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
    void reason;
    for (const item of items) {
      await step(item);
    }
    for (const item of items) {
      // want: await-in-loop-javascript
      await audit(item);
    }
  }
}

export const inOrderSteps = async (steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> => {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
  for (const step of steps) {
    // want: await-in-loop-javascript
    await audit(step);
  }
};

async function j17StepPair(items: string[], db: Db) {
  await inOrder(items, async (item) => {
    // want: sequential-awaits-javascript
    const a = await db.get(item);
    const b = await db.other(item);
    console.log(a, b);
  }, { reason: "Each write reads the previous write state" });
}

async function j18StepWidthAssign(items: string[], db: Db) {
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i = i + 10) {
    await Promise.all(items.slice(i, i + 10).map((item) => db.get(item)));
  }
}
